description: This PHP source file defines the PIMLeftMenuService class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. The class provides functionality to generate and manage left menu items for the PIM module, including caching mechanisms, permission checks, and integrations with other services and traits. It's part of a human resource management system, specifically handling menu-related logic for a specific employee or user context.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuService
classes.description: A service class managing the generation, caching, and permission-based filtering of the PIM left menu items within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: getEmployeeService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeService, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: setEmployeeService
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeService instance used by this service.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves menu items for a specified employee, either from cache or by generating anew.

methods.name: clearCachedMenu
methods.description: Clears cached menu data for a specific employee or all employees.

methods.name: isPimAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the PIM menu is accessible based on user permissions.

methods.name: generateMenuItems
methods.description: Generates menu items based on user permissions and employee state.

methods.name: isEmployeeWorkflowActionsAllowed
methods.description: Determines whether workflow actions are permitted for a given employee.

methods.name: getMenuFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached menu items for an employee from the session.

methods.name: saveMenuInCache
methods.description: Stores generated menu items into session cache for an employee.

methods.name: getAvailableActions
methods.description: Returns the list of available menu actions, potentially filtering out tax exemptions based on config.

methods.name: isTaxMenuEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the tax exemption menu is enabled in configuration.

methods.name: getPreparedMenuItems
methods.description: Prepares and formats menu items with URLs and active status for display in the UI.
